Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that the nano-compound studied in the article "Diamond photonic crystal slab: Leaky modes and modified photoluminescence emission of surface-deposited quantum dots" was "cadmium selenide" instead of "diamond". While the article mentions quantum dots (likely cadmium selenide), the main focus of the study is on the diamond photonic crystal slab, as evidenced by the article's title and abstract. The Planner failed to prioritize the primary subject of the study (diamond) over a secondary material mentioned in the context of experimental details. This misinterpretation led to the incorrect solution to the problem.
